hero.title: Complete Business Control.
hero.subtitle: Manage orders, generate receipts, track revenue, and automate via Telegram — all from a single platform built for European businesses.

trust.badge: Trusted by businesses across UA & EU

features.label: Platform
features.title: Everything your business needs. Nothing it doesn't.

operations.label: Operations Management
operations.title: Products, Orders & Customers in one place
operations.description: Full CRUD for products with margin tracking, multi-item orders with status workflows, and customer management with Telegram integration.

financial.label: Financial Control
financial.title: Receipts, Revenue & Turnover analytics
financial.description: Generate professional PDF receipts from 10 templates in 3 languages. Track revenue by product, by customer, and over time with exportable analytics.

automation.label: Automation & Security
automation.title: Telegram bot, audit logs & enterprise security
automation.description: Accept orders via Telegram bot with cart UI. Every operation is audit-logged. Row-Level Security ensures complete tenant data isolation.
automation.item2: Full audit trail on every change

differentiators.label: Enterprise Grade
differentiators.title: Built for serious businesses
differentiators.subtitle: Technical foundations that set ReceiptMaster apart from generic tools.

rls.title: Multi-Tenant RLS Isolation
rls.description: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security on every table. Each tenant's data is invisible to others at the database level.

pdf.title: Background PDF Generation
pdf.description: Receipts generated asynchronously via BullMQ queue with Playwright. No request blocking, automatic retries, horizontal scaling.

hash.title: Receipt Integrity Verification
hash.description: Every receipt is SHA256-hashed. Verify document authenticity at any time. HTML snapshots stored for complete audit trail.
